title: GST standard rate 7% to 8% on 1 January 2023
summary: GST Act s 16 and the IRAS rate page move the standard rate from 7% to 8% for the calendar year 2023. Reverse charge and Overseas Vendor Registration, which track the standard rate, move with it. From the same date, reverse charge is extended to low-value goods purchased by RC Businesses, and OVR is extended to B2C low-value goods and B2C remote non-digital services.

changes.summary: Standard-rated GST, including GST collected under reverse charge and Overseas Vendor Registration, moves from 7% to 8%.

migration_impact.summary: Invoices and GST F5 returns for supplies from 1 January 2023 use 8%. Supplies through 31 December 2022 stay at 7%. Zero-rated, exempt, and out-of-scope treatments are unchanged.

changes.summary: Reverse charge is extended to imported low-value goods purchased by RC Businesses, and Overseas Vendor Registration is extended to B2C low-value goods (air/post, value not exceeding S$400) and B2C remote non-digital services.

migration_impact.summary: Systems that already handled imported B2B services or B2C digital services must add low-value goods (and, for OVR, remote non-digital services) from 1 January 2023.
